# Issue590: train member Lean-delta titles

Fresh Sol/Ultra native orc, one implementation task. MAIN owns main-fix590.
Work ONLY in /home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/.worktrees/issue-590-train-lean-delta,
branch issue-590-train-lean-delta, freshly based on published main.
Read /tmp/issue590-author-input-20260918.json for the exact trusted_main and
the owner's concrete requirement. Validate the starting HEAD equals that ref.

Read trusted AGENTS.md, local/DESIGN.md, local/personas/orchestrator.md and
relevant workflow/commit/test rules with git show at that trusted ref.
The owner single-key rules override obsolete dispatcher instructions: no
codex exec, dispatch.sh, review.sh, autofix, lanes, descendants or other
models/keys. No primary-tree writes, GitHub writes, push, ci.sh, full lake
build, daemon edits or live train. Normal hooks remain binding.

The owner requires Lean deltas on every first-parent merge commit on main.
Ordinary merges already use pr_merge.lean_line_delta and merge_commit_title
(issue557/PR558). The newly merged train still commits each member at
local/bin/pr_train.py:125 with a bare Merge PR #N into reviewed train subject.
That misses the existing policy. No commit-msg hook supplies the suffix.

Implement the narrow correction in the train using the existing formatter
and measurement semantics. Inspect those APIs and current integration/tests
before choosing the implementation. Each member delta is measured against
the immediately preceding accepted train state and the actual merged result,
not the original train base or an unrelated old member base. Preserve normal
zero/failure behavior and closing-reference sanitization. Avoid a parallel
counting policy or unnecessary abstractions.

Scope: local/bin/pr_train.py, focused train fixtures (existing test module or
a small focused companion matching its patterns), and a concise dated
protocol/EVOLUTION note if needed to document this existing-policy integration.
No Lean, blueprint, mathematics, claim contract, daemon or unrelated refactor.
Preserve member heads, content, topology, conflict dropping, claim lifetime,
review gates, leased transport and post-push checks. The owner-authorized
transport contract is already reviewed and merged; do not reopen it.

Add meaningful Git-backed fixture coverage for additions/deletions, zero
delta and two sequential members whose counts must not become cumulative.
Use existing fixture helpers and include a case showing unrelated newer-main
Lean content is not counted as a member deletion if useful. Verify each new
first-parent train merge subject, not only a formatter mock. Reuse existing
sanitization/failure tests where sufficient; do not run live publication.

Run focused tests and relevant syntax/lint checks. Do not repeat a full suite
after required normal commit hooks have already run it successfully. Preserve
any failed diagnostics. Use apply_patch for manual edits. Invoke workflow
tools through /home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/local/bin from repo root, with this
worktree explicitly where supported. Check setup and hooks; canonical warming
is allowed if needed, never manual shared-cache/package writes.

Budget ceiling900s, hard stop2026-09-18T04:41:01Z including all checks and receipt;
reserve final180s. Use this absolute deadline, not first-shell time plus900.
No extension or automatic retry. Make a normal local commit
with a short imperative type(scope) subject, no closing-keyword examples.
Do not publish or claim independent approval. Return a precise checkpoint
if the task exceeds its scope or a required gate is still running.

Write /tmp/issue590-train-titles-20260918-receipt.md and
/tmp/issue590-train-titles-20260918-manifest.sha256 via apply_patch: base/head,
changed paths, measurement boundary, verified behavior/tests/logs/hashes,
actual times, and a draft PR body (Motivation/Description/Testing; Addresses590).
Stop after this task for retirement. MAIN handles publication, CI and a
fresh independent review before any live train use.
publication: local implementation only; no live train/CI/push assigned
